|game_text='''0 side — Center Of Tyranny'''

''Deploy [Virtual Block 7] Coruscant, Main Power Plant, Lower Levels, Planetary Shield, and [[Rogue Insertion]].'' For remainder of game, Rogue Squadron pilots are Insurgents and may fire blasters for free. Your destiny draws for [Virtual Block 1] Sabotage are -1 and may not be further reduced. Your characters of ability > 4 are deploy +4. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Coruscant battleground site. Flip this card if Planetary Shield ‘disabled.’

'''7 side — A Liberated World'''

Immediately retrieve into hand (or ▲) any one card. While this side up, “1” on [[Declaration Of Rebellion{{!}}Declaration of Rebellion]] is treated as “2”. Your Force generation at Coruscant system is +2. While you occupy a system, your Force drains are +1 at each related battleground site you control with a Rogue Squadron pilot. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a starship from a system, you may lose 1 Force to steal it into hand. Once during your turn, if you just forfeited a Rogue Squadron pilot, may use 1 Force to ▲ any one card.
|versions='''Virtual Legacy''' — '''this page''' (<code>1273_42</code>)
|errata_history=This card has one published text. The images are the Players Committee card images of both sides and the Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip (cut in two halves per side: [[:File:VB7-00-Center_Of_Tyranny_A_Liberated_World.png]] / [[:File:VB7-p7-125-Dantooine_Base_Operations.png]] and [[:File:VB7-07-A_Liberated_World.png]] / [[:File:VB7-p7-126-More_Dangerous_Than_You_Realize.png]]); the slip was printed to sleeve on Dantooine Base Operations (V) / More Dangerous Than You Realize (V). All of them print this text.
* First printed in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), Light Side p. 7: Center Of Tyranny: “Deploy [Virtual Block 7] Coruscant, Main Power Plant, Lower Levels, Planetary Shield, and Rogue Insertion. For remainder of game, Rogue Squadron pilots are Insurgents and may fire blasters for free. Your destiny draws for [Virtual Block 1] Sabotage are -1 and may not be further reduced. Your characters of ability > 4 are deploy +4. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Coruscant battleground site. Flip this card if Planetary Shield ‘disabled.’” A Liberated World: “Immediately retrieve into hand (or ▲) any one card. While this side up, “1” on Declaration of Rebellion is treated as “2”. Your Force generation at Coruscant system is +2. While you occupy a system, your Force drains are +1 at each related battleground site you control with a Rogue Squadron pilot. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a starship from a system, you may lose 1 Force to steal it into hand. Once during your turn, if you just forfeited a Rogue Squadron pilot, may use 1 Force to ▲ any one card.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 7, slip 42 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>
* The Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text (Light Side p. 47).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=47, page 47. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=47 Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list shows no game text for objectives.
